name: Montpelier & Stowe
summary: The smallest state capital in America, plus ice cream from the source and a steepled ski village under Mount Mansfield.

lodging.name: Trapp Family Lodge, Stowe
lodging.blurb: Austrian-style mountain lodge founded by the von Trapps of Sound of Music fame — meadows, trails, and a brewery.

foodMustTry.name: A Ben & Jerry's factory scoop
foodMustTry.blurb: Tour the Waterbury factory and pay respects at the Flavor Graveyard.

foodMustTry.name: Vermont cheddar & a maple creemee
foodMustTry.blurb: Sharp local cheddar and a maple soft-serve — the state's signatures.

days.label: Day 46 — Montpelier & Ben & Jerry's
days.summary: The gold-domed little capital, then ice cream in Waterbury.

item.title: Vermont State House
item.blurb: The gold-domed capital of the only U.S. state capital without a McDonald's — small, walkable, and proud of it.

item.title: Ben & Jerry's Factory Tour
item.blurb: A short factory tour ending in samples, plus the tongue-in-cheek Flavor Graveyard.

days.label: Day 47 — Stowe & Mount Mansfield
days.summary: The village and the ridgeline of Vermont's highest peak.

item.title: Mount Mansfield Auto Toll Road
item.blurb: Drive or hike to the ridgeline of Vermont's highest peak for foliage views across the Greens.

item.title: Stowe village & the rec path
item.blurb: The white-steepled village, covered bridge, and a stroll or bike on the rec path.

days.label: Day 48 — Smugglers' Notch
days.summary: A dramatic mountain pass and the Trapp meadows.

item.title: Smugglers' Notch
item.blurb: A narrow pass of house-sized boulders and 1,000-ft cliffs (closed to cars in winter).

item.title: Trapp Family Lodge meadows & brewery
item.blurb: Alpine meadows, walking trails, and a lager in the von Trapp brewery.

item.title: The Vermont Ski and Snowboard Museum
item.blurb: In the old town hall on Stowe's main street, in the town that has a fair claim to being where American skiing started. Rope tows and wooden rope-tow gripper mitts, the story of the 10th Mountain Division, and a snowboard collection that takes the sport seriously — Vermont produced Burton, and it shows.

days.label: Day 49 — Down to the lake
days.summary: A short hop to Burlington on Lake Champlain.

commute.scenicNote: West to Vermont's biggest city on the lake.
